description: This file defines a ProgressController class and related functions for managing progress, timeouts, and abort signals within the Playwright core server. It handles task execution with timeout and cancellation support, and logs progress events.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: Manages progress, timeout, and abort signals for asynchronous tasks, including logging and error handling.

methods.name: createForSdkObject
methods.description: Creates a ProgressController instance for a specific SDK object with logging.

methods.name: runInternalTask
methods.description: Runs an internal task with progress management and optional timeout.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing progress with an error.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a task with progress tracking, timeout, and cancellation support.
